name: Disneyland Oga's Cantina "Blue Bantha" Chilled Blue Milk with Vanilla-Butter Sugar Cookie & Five-Blossom Pretzel Bread
brandOrRestaurant: Oga's Cantina (Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Most drinks at Oga's Cantina are loaded with lemon/lime/grapefruit juice—the **Blue Bantha** (chilled dairy-free coconut/rice Blue Milk topped with a soft vanilla-butter Bantha-horn sugar cookie) and warm **Five-Blossom Pretzel Bread** (eat plain without mustard) are the two citrus-free winners!
prepOrOrderInstructions: Inside Oga's Cantina, order the non-alcoholic **Blue Bantha** and warm **Five-Blossom Bread** (skip the spicy mustard cheese dip); strictly avoid Fuzzy Tauntaun, Jedi Mind Trick (grapefruit!), Bespin Fizz, and Oga's Obsession (lemonade!).
watchOuts: CRITICAL CITRUS WARNING at Oga's: Almost every other cocktail/mocktail in Oga's Cantina contains grapefruit, lemon, lime, or orange juice—stick to Blue Bantha or water!
